title: myrteola humifusa
intro: Myrteola humifusa, commonly known as the Korean mountain tea, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Myrtaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Myrteola humifusa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Myrteola humifusa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
